summary: Wrote an 8-phase lean4 plan porting report 03's naming-rule soundness toolkit into the library: L-plus truth invariance along a HistMorphism plus a TwoWayBounded notion and its discrete-time lift derivation in FormalSystem/Semantics/HistoryMorphism.lean, and freshness, the clock rule, Gabbay's IRR rule and the auxiliary-atoms expansion in a new FormalSystem/Metalogic/NamingRules.lean. Pre-planning codebase sweep found the probe's clock product already present as FrameOver.translationProduct with every supporting fact, so deliverables (2) and (3) need no frame construction, and found a located obstruction for deliverable (4): the probe's step-counting List path record is incompatible with TaskFrame.Compositional. Phase 7 is therefore budget-bounded with a sanctioned [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] outcome.
